notes.note: All 1,287 actual source units inventoried before source review. Original flat-array refs, chapter values, anchors and wording are retained; Greek/Septuagint chapter divisions remain authoritative. No missing units are invented and inventory/import adds no completed review credit.

notes: Every one of the 139 source units has at least one retained supported pair; a target range counts as one pair.
Numbers 1:18 states first day of the month of the second year without the month number stated in 1:1; its source text remains unchanged.
The actual edition places the earlier 603,550 census figure at Exodus 39:3; the target key is not silently renumbered.

The edition gives Merari 6,050 at Numbers 3:34, Kohath 8,600 at 3:28, Gershon 7,500 at 3:22, and total Levi 22,000 at 3:39. The clan figures sum to 22,150; no reconciliation, emendation, or unsupported explanation is asserted. The excess-firstborn relation uses the explicitly stated 22,000 total, 22,273 firstborn, and 273 excess.

Numbers 4 service eligibility is twenty-five through fifty in these actual English records, distinguished from Numbers 3 population counts beginning at one month and Numbers 1 military counts beginning at twenty years.

Eliasaph son of Reuel (Gad) and Eliasaph son of Lael (Gershon) are not conflated; chief Elizaphan son of Uzziel is retained only with the explicit local Kohathite constituency, avoiding assumed identity across differing Elzaphan spellings.

Camp and departure parallels preserve the source orientation southwest, toward the sea, north, and east; the transport comparison preserves distinct Gershon/Merari and Kohath movements rather than harmonizing them into one asserted sequence.
All targets are confined to the authorized Saints canon; no Revelation text or excluded book is used.
Initial English-passage cross-reference pass; no claim of independent human specialist or Greek/Hebrew apparatus review.
Actual service age is twenty-five through fifty throughout Numbers 4; no familiar-edition thirty-year substitution.
Covering colours, items, carrying poles, shoulders, priestly supervision, non-touching and viewing precautions follow the actual English records, including the basin clause in Numbers 4:14.
Same-chapter entries deliberately identify command/fulfilment, specific introduction/content, summary/case, sequence, census population/count or component/total relations. They are labelled as such.

The jealousy law distinguishes concealed defilement, absent witnesses, jealous suspicion even where undefiled, conditional curses, and an unharmed clean outcome. No modern medical mechanism or current legal recommendation is inferred.
A subset of candidate passages was read for context but was not retained; reading and verification alone create no completion credit.
All 77 intrachapter relationship labels explicitly begin Same-chapter after peer audit. Final row counts remain 80 completed sources, 142 retained pairs and 175 distinct target units.
Preserved the actual chapter6 ending at verse26, with the divine-name statement within verse23; no customary verse27 was created.

Retained Numbers7 repetitions by linking each exact gift to its corresponding aggregate and later donors once to the first matching gift. Did not generate all pairwise combinations among twelve equivalent presentations.

The repeated donations preserve every donor, day, material, weight, animal category, sex, age and quantity. Aggregate links explain 2400 silver, 120 gold, twelve animals by category, twenty-four heifers and sixty of each deliverance group.
Preserved the actual twenty-five-year service threshold in Numbers4 and Numbers8, contrasting it with the twenty-year Chronicles arrangement.
Numbers8:26 is read according to its actual English subject, his brother, without importing a familiar alternative edition's wording.
Speech-introduction pairs identify the particular instruction and literary function of each speech, rather than merely comparing a generic revelation formula.

notes.note: Preserve the first-month anniversary and second-month exception, observed corpse impurity versus unexcused failure conditions, native/sojourner scope, meal and bone rules, and Moses' particular consultation. The later Chronicle postponement and impurity narrative retain their own circumstances and voices.

Cloud and fire, camping and departure, many days, a number of days, evening/morning/day/night and a month remain the source's stated cases. No new harmonized timetable or identical-date assumption is supplied.

Preserve two hammered silver trumpets, one-trumpet ruler summons, assembly versus departure signalling, all four actual directional signals, priestly association, war-in-the-land wording and calendar/offerings memorial. Later military and temple occasions are related examples, not silently identical legal settings.

Leader names/patronymics and the earlier camp formations are matched in their actual English. Gershon/Merari tent duties and Kohath holy-object carrying retain their distinct materials and conditions. The Tent-before-arrival pronoun wording is retained without independently assigning its unstated subject.

Preserve Hobab/Reuel, the refusal and renewed invitation, elder rather than an imported eyes wording, the ark's rest-search role, and actual34 prayer/35 rest/36 cloud order. Psalms67/80/131 keep Greek-edition references. The possible Hobab/Jobab identity in Judges4:11 is recorded pending and excluded from completed pairs.
